excluded.description: The software shall record analytics events for the post-test lobby, comprising lobby display with the completion state of each action, and action, done, undone, collapse and expand interactions, each identifying the action type.
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: Withdrawn at Guy's direction, 12 Aug 2026. Withdrawn at Guy's direction: the lobby analytics event set is feature-spec detail, not a functional requirement. FR-ANL-001 already requires analytics for progress through the test flow. Was a deferred backlog item and is not carried into milestone 5.

excluded.description: The backend shall independently re-validate image quality and block a result where thresholds are not met
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: RESOLVED. The current RA draft has replaced the backend re-validation clause in RA 7.16 with “Software Algorithms safely invalidate scans…”, which FR-IMG-015 covers. No further RA edit is needed.

excluded.description: No configuration value shall be capable of disabling a requirement that implements a risk control
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — an addition of this document. The intent is now largely met by other means: the timing values in section 12, the PIN parameters in section 18 and the readiness thresholds in section 5 are stated as fixed in the application rather than configurable, so they are not reachable by configuration. The residual exposure is the controls that remain configuration-driven, principally the IVTS thresholds and the demonstration flags, and FR-CFG-004 covers the latter server-side.

excluded.description: User-facing text supplied by configuration shall be drawn from the approved content set and meet section 10
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — an addition of this document. Note the consequence: customBlockFlowAlertParams carries a free-text title and body set per partner, so blocking-message text can be authored outside the approved content set and outside the grade-6 reading level required by FR-TXT-001.

excluded.description: The device software shall be developed and maintained in accordance with the Class B classification under IEC 62304
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — the classification is stated in RA section 6 and the obligation stands irrespective of this document. Development standards belong in the Software Development Plan; FR-LCM-017 covers release testing.

excluded.description: Usability testing shall evaluate whether the user understands each content requirement that is a risk control
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: PARTIAL — RA 7.3, 7.6 and 7.19 each cite usability testing of the instruction as a mitigation. FR-LCM-012 retains usability testing but only for platform coverage and interruptions, so evaluation of instructional comprehension is no longer required by this document. Confirm it is covered by the Usability Engineering Plan, otherwise those three RA clauses have no verification activity.

excluded.description: The reading level of all user-facing text shall be measured before each release
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — no RA row cites it. Note that FR-TXT-001 remains at milestone 2, so the grade-6 ceiling is required but no longer has a stated verification activity in this document.

excluded.description: Component names shall be reconciled against the Product Glossary at each release
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — no RA row cites it. As above, FR-TXT-002 remains at milestone 2 without a stated verification activity here.

excluded.description: If the Urine Collection Cup was filled, disable cancellation, complete the test flow and upload the data
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — SRS TSM.20 maps to it and should be marked withdrawn when the SRS is updated. FR-STA-008 still bars cancellation once the cup is filled, so the gate remains; what is no longer stated is the positive obligation to carry the test through to upload.

excluded.description: The instructional flow shall present the safety information applicable to buffer or reagent contact with skin or eyes, including the instruction to rinse with water
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — RA 2.2, 2.5 and 7.36 each assign the safety warning and the rinse instruction to the User Manual alone. There is no in-app clause to delete, so the Risk Analysis is unaffected.

excluded.description: Record the type of consent given and the time it was given, and transmit both to the backend
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — consent recording remains future development as FR-CNS-007 at milestone 5, which is where the obligation and the Q-11 decision sit. The identifier was issued for one draft revision on a mistaken reading of a review comment and is recorded here so that it is not reissued.

excluded.description: The application-store rating prompt shall not be presented during an active test, on a results screen, or after an invalid test
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — an addition of this document. Note that the rating prompt itself is future development as FR-ANL-009, so nothing currently triggers the prompt. If FR-ANL-009 is implemented, the constraint should be reconsidered.

excluded.description: The software shall be published with automatic update enabled wherever the application store supports it
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — RA 4.17 relies on the version check in FR-RDY-004, which blocks an unsupported application version outright, rather than on automatic update. The RA clause is satisfied without this requirement.

excluded.description: Present the framing guidance in spoken form during scanning
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: NO — RA 7.12, 7.14 and 7.16 trace to FR-IMG-024.

excluded.description: Where the phone number and invite code do uniquely identify a single registered user, the software shall not request the Date of Birth at login
excluded.risk_analysis_impact: RESOLVED. The Date of Birth is not part of login in this version. Requesting it at login is only meaningful where more than one patient shares a phone number or an address, and both cases are future development as FR-AUT-007 and FR-AUT-011, so the condition was always true and the requirement was satisfied by writing no code. The Date of Birth confirmation at the start of every test, FR-AUT-012, is unaffected and is now milestone 3. The traceability is also reconciled: RA 6.4 traces to FR-AUT-010, FR-AUT-012, FR-AUT-013, FR-AUT-014 and FR-SHR-003, all in scope and all at milestone 3. That single list replaces the two inconsistent lists this appendix and the note now carried by FR-AUT-007 previously held.

superseded.description: Detect out-of-sequence assay signatures and block a result where present
superseded.disposition: Capability not achievable; FR-ALG-008 states the detectable conditions instead
superseded.risk_analysis_impact: RESOLVED IN THE RISK ANALYSIS, EXCEPT RA 7.34. Nine rows cited “Software Algorithms detect out-of-sequence assay signatures and block invalid results”. Out-of-sequence detection is not achievable. What is achievable, and is required by FR-ALG-008, is detecting that the sample was not introduced into the buffer and that insufficient fluid reached the Detection Wells. The rows resolve as follows. RA 3.8, no fluid flow to the detection wells, is covered by the insufficient-fluid detection. RA 3.9 and RA 3.10, the release button operated before incubation is complete, no longer rely on software detection; RA 3.9 relies on the instruction and the timer, which are FR-TXT-015, FR-TIM-007 and FR-TIM-009. RA 7.9, 7.23, 7.29, 7.30 and 7.36 each retain at least one other requirement at milestone 1 to 3. RA 7.34, the test performed at extreme ambient temperature or humidity, is not yet resolved and is the one row whose only software control is a requirement at TBD priority.

consolidated.description: Detect whether the Test Board is entirely within the camera frame
consolidated.risk_analysis_impact: NO — SRS TSM.10 now traces to FR-IMG-002.

consolidated.description: Capture a set of images rather than a single image and transmit the complete set
consolidated.risk_analysis_impact: NO — SRS PER.2, PER.3 and the Glossary now trace to FR-CAM-001.

consolidated.description: Prevent an additional test where the kit identifier has already been used
consolidated.risk_analysis_impact: NO — SRS TSM.40 now traces to FR-KIT-004.

consolidated.description: Persistently retain the current test state throughout the test flow
consolidated.risk_analysis_impact: NO — the persistence obligation and all five RA traces (4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.18) were carried into FR-STA-003 rather than dropped.

consolidated.description: On return to the application, resume at the active step and make instructions available for replay
Prevent the Test Board being scanned before the colour-evolution period has elapsed
consolidated.risk_analysis_impact: NO — RA 4.4 now traces to FR-TIM-008 as well as FR-TIM-011.
